correctness.rationale: Exact generator identities yield a concave quadratic formula for Var(y); its nonnegativity gives the discriminant obstruction and root factorization. Compact invariant sets support invariant measures, bounded forward orbits have compact omega-limit sets, and the z-sign plus regularized-log argument rigorously gives the harmonic identity. The saddle-node endpoint argument correctly yields the unique compactly supported invariant probability measure.

originality.rationale: The 2007 Starkov--Starkov abstract already proves the weaker no-periodic-orbit statement without equilibria and studies compact-set localization, so that prior work is credited. The inspected 2024 invariant-measure paper approximates Rössler measures numerically but does not state the exact parameter-uniform laws or compact-recurrence equivalence. No inspected source states the full result; the inaccessible 2007 full text remains a material residual risk.

value.rationale: The theorem identifies the equilibrium discriminant as the exact threshold for existence of any compact invariant dynamics in the positive-parameter Rössler family, rules out all bounded forward trajectories below it, and provides exact statistical constraints for every compact invariant measure above it, including variance collapse and an arithmetic-harmonic mean law.
